bullets: The New York City health department was still scrambling to hire, onboard and train new water ecologists to help prevent and contain Legionnaires’ disease outbreaks — a stated priority for the department following a deadly outbreak of the disease in Harlem last summer — when a fresh cluster of cases was identified on the Upper East Side earlier this month, according to new staffing figures the agency shared with Gothamist.
